dataset_purpose: Formal retrieval evaluation for Dense vs Hybrid vs Hybrid+Reranker.

document.title: Guidelines on Prevention of Money Laundering, Countering Financing of Terrorism, Countering Proliferation Financing and Targeted Financial Sanctions for Reporting Institutions in the Capital Market

development.purpose: May be inspected when diagnosing retrieval failures and tuning retrieval configuration.

heldout.purpose: Reserved for final retrieval comparisons. Do not tune Dense/Hybrid/Reranker behavior using held-out results.

relevance_policy.primary_chunk_ids: Directly answer-bearing evidence used for core retrieval metrics.
relevance_policy.supporting_chunk_ids: Useful related context; not counted as a primary hit in core metrics.
relevance_policy.required_evidence_groups: Each inner group represents one required evidence need. v1 uses singleton groups; schema supports alternatives later.

recommended_metrics.Hit@K: 1 if at least one primary_chunk_id appears in top K; otherwise 0.
recommended_metrics.Recall@K: Number of primary_chunk_ids retrieved in top K divided by number of primary_chunk_ids.
recommended_metrics.MRR: Reciprocal rank of the first primary_chunk_id.
recommended_metrics.CompleteEvidence@K: 1 if every required_evidence_group is represented in top K; otherwise 0.
recommended_metrics.macro_aggregation: Average metrics across questions; report dev and held-out separately.

questions.question: Which factors must be considered when determining a customer's ML/TF/PF risk profile?
questions.rationale: Customer, geography, products/services, channels and other higher-risk information.

questions.question: What actions are required when a reporting institution cannot satisfactorily complete CDD for a customer?

questions.question: What does ongoing due diligence require, and how should the frequency and intensity of monitoring be determined?

questions.question: When must a suspicious transaction be reported to FIED, and does the amount of the transaction affect the obligation to lodge an STR?

questions.question: After a terrorism-financing sanctions name match is confirmed, what immediate actions are required, and what additional rules apply to attempted transactions and false-positive checks?
